title: Quantitative analysis of mRNA expression using dual RNA in situ hybridization
author: Byung Joon Seung
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.badcia2w

steps.title: Convert original images to Tritanope
steps.instruction: Convert the original RNA-ISH images (acquired at ×400 magnification) using the Fiji program.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Image → Color → Dichromacy → Tritanope
Save the resulting images as Tiff files

steps.title: Extract 'a' channel images
steps.instruction: Convert the Tritanope-filtered images to CIELAB color space using the Fiji program.

substeps.instruction: Acquire the 'a' channel images as jpg files

steps.title: Quantify red dots
steps.instruction: Measure red dots in the 'a' channel images using the ICY program.

substeps.instruction: Use the spot detector in white spot detection mode
Set the size of spots to detect to scale 3
Adjust filter conditions as needed for the specific research

steps.title: Quantify blue dots
steps.instruction: Measure blue dots in the Tritanope filtered images using the ICY program.

substeps.instruction: Use the spot detector in dark spot detection mode
Set the size of spots to detect to scale 2
Adjust filter conditions as needed for the specific research
